mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, t.sprint_id AS sprintId, s.name AS sprintName, t.title, t.content, t.priority, t.status, t.assignee, t.creator, t.estimate_hours AS estimateHours, t.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, t.created_at AS createdAt, t.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM task t LEFT JOIN project p ON t.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN sprint s ON t.sprint_id = s.id
mapper.select: WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
WHERE t.sprint_id = #{sprintId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (project_id, sprint_id, title, content, priority, status, assignee, creator, estimate_hours, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{sprintId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{assignee}, #{creator}, #{estimateHours}, #{resolvedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = #{status}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
